title: A Static for the Vector
author: Ansel Okonkwo
blurb: Odile Iversen, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
